relationships.subject: remifentanil-induced postoperative hyperalgesia
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 and phosphorylated NF-κB were upregulated in group RIH compared to group R or I

key_findings: Remifentanil plus incision upregulates TLR4, p-NF-κB and TRPA1 in rat DRG neurons.
Blocking TLR4 (TAK-242) reduced TRPA1 and mechanical allodynia, whereas blocking TRPA1 did not alter TLR4 signaling, placing TRPA1 downstream of TLR4.
